page.overview:
Who is Ash?

Ash the Warlock is Marceline's immortal, wizard ex-boyfriend who has his debut appearance in "Memory of a Memory". Marceline broke up with him because he sold Hambo, her favorite teddy bear, to Maja the Sky Witch in exchange for a new Cherry Blossom Wand. Disguised as a Rag Wizard, he used Finn and Jake to get a hold of Marceline's memory core containing her memory of breaking up with him so that he could destroy it, effectively making it like the break up never happened. When Marceline wakes up, he and Marceline go to his house where he asks Marceline to make him dinner. She then finds out what happened by viewing Finn's memory of her memory of breaking up with him. Marceline comes out of Ash's house with Finn and they jump on him and kick him, while Jake stretches into a giant sized foot and stomps on him at the end.

Ash reappears briefly in the episode "Betty" when Simon Petrikov steals his flying carpet to escape Wizard City. Ironically, both Simon and Ash were close to Marceline at different times, but neither knew the other. Ash mentions being a busker in Wizard City, and is shown to still have his Cherry Blossom Wand. Later in the episode, Marceline willingly sacrifices Hambo so Simon can reunite with his lost love, Betty Grof.

He appeared again in "Gumbaldia" and joined Gumbald's army to attack and conquer the Candy Kingdom.

The Rag Wizard is an alias Ash created to trick Finn and Jake. This disguise makes him green skinned with a beard that has its end tied, and clothes made of rags making him look more like a hobo than a wizard. He allegedly had no arms, and thus used his feet to interact with things. He claimed that he was Marceline's "spirit animal." As soon as Finn and Jake find the memory of Ash and Marceline's break up, he reveals that he is really Ash.
